basic_profile.bio: A curious soul from Portland, Oregon, diving into the world of Reddit for the first time. Passionate about music, particularly indie bands, and a dedicated member of the BandCamp community. By day, I work as a junior graphic designer, and by night, I explore the depths of Reddit. Single and figuring out the dating scene, I often find myself drawn to relationship advice threads. I also have a soft spot for meme stocks and furry communities, which keep my Reddit experience diverse and entertaining. Typically online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in graphic design from a local college and a knack for self-teaching, I've spent countless hours honing my skills through online courses and YouTube tutorials. I've recently taken an interest in financial markets, especially meme stocks, and I'm slowly learning the ropes through community discussions.
